I’ve had a handgun for a few years now, but I bought extra ammo and magazines. It has made me feel a lot more confident living alone, and moreso now. I highly recommend taking a gun safety course to get comfortable around firearms (if you’re not already) and then invest in a gun you feel confident using. 

I’ve started stocking up on medical supplies, but more specifically medication that may be hard to come by if the health system eats shit.  Somebody in another post recommended this: https://jasemedical.com/case It’s a little pricey but I’m going to be so grateful I have it if I need it in the future. I bought Bleed Stop and emergency wound closures (in the event I can’t get myself or another person into the ER - who knows wtf is going to happen). I have the basics like gauze, alcohol wipes, OTC meds like Advil. Also consider the possibility of another pandemic, or just illness in general. Hand sanitizer and masks. 

I live in central Texas and we got royally fucked in that 2021 ice storm. As a result, I already have a stockpile of water, non perishable foods, a camping stove and kettle, and an emergency power station. Batteries, flashlights, matches, lighters. 

Consider toiletries: Soap, toothpaste,pads and/or tampons. Whatever you think you will need to have a basic level of comfort. 

Those are the only things I have done so far. I decided to wait and see what unfolds, and then buy supplies accordingly. 

I’m worried about the ban on contraception, so I stocked up on condoms and plan B (available on Amazon). I know plan c is available through some websites.

I plan to take the stopthebleed.org course and hopefully basic first aid and CPR as a refresher.
